title: In silico screening and identifying phytoconstituents of Withania somnifera as potent inhibitors of BRCA1 mutants: A therapeutic against breast cancer.
authors: Panda, Smita Manjari; Nandeshwar; Tripathy, Umakanta
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD筛选植物成分抑制BRCA1突变蛋白，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但非TF-DNA体系，相关性有限。
abstract: Breast CAncer gene 1 (BRCA1) is an anti-oncogene that helps the cell repair damaged DNA and preserve genetic material. BRCA1 also acts as a cell growth suppressor and produces tumor suppressor gene (TSG) proteins, i.e., BRCA1 protein. Remarkably, BRCA1 mutations account for 90% of hereditary breast cancer and a majority of hereditary ovarian cancer. Hence, we have considered three mutants of BRCA1 (R1699W, R1699Q, T1700A) in this study and adopted an in-silico approach to find the best possible phytochemical to inhibit these mutated proteins, enabling early breast cancer diagnosis. Perceiving the importance, many natural molecules from ancient medicinal plants are considered for molecular docking. Our findings suggest that though many molecules bind actively with the receptor's active site, the top three phytoconstituents (27-Deoxy-14-hydroxywithaferin A, Withacoagulin, Somniferanolide) of Withania somnifera, commonly known as Ashwagandha, have high binding affinities and suitable pharmacokinetic properties, making these natural compounds potential drug candidates. Further, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation and the binding free energy calculation show stability and thermodynamically favourable. We can, therefore, draw the conclusion that these lead compounds act as potential inhibitors against BRCA1. However, wet lab experiments and clinical trials are recommended to ascertain its efficacy, hence the development of novel BRCA1 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌易感基因1（BRCA1）是一种抗癌基因，帮助细胞修复受损DNA并保持遗传物质。BRCA1还作为细胞生长抑制因子，产生肿瘤抑制基因（TSG）蛋白，即BRCA1蛋白。值得注意的是，BRCA1突变占遗传性乳腺癌的90%以及大多数遗传性卵巢癌。因此，本研究考虑了BRCA1的三个突变体（R1699W、R1699Q、T1700A），并采用计算机模拟（in-silico）方法寻找最佳植物化学物质以抑制这些突变蛋白，从而实现早期乳腺癌诊断。鉴于其重要性，我们考虑了来自古代药用植物的多种天然分子进行分子对接（molecular docking）。我们的研究结果表明，尽管许多分子能与受体活性位点活跃结合，但来自南非醉茄（Withania somnifera，俗称Ashwagandha）的前三种植物成分（27-Deoxy-14-hydroxywithaferin A、Withacoagulin、Somniferanolide）具有高结合亲和力和合适的药代动力学特性，使这些天然化合物成为潜在的药物候选物。此外，分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和结合自由能计算显示其稳定性和热力学有利性。因此，我们可以得出结论，这些先导化合物可作为BRCA1的潜在抑制剂。然而，建议进行湿实验和临床试验以确认其有效性，从而开发新型BRCA1抑制剂。
